name: McCovey Cove
say: Off the ballpark. Bring a glove for the splash hits.

ashore.name: the ballpark promenade
ashore.say: Garlic fries and a cold one on the promenade, with the game on the big screen.

name: Ayala Cove
say: Angel Island's landing: moorings, a beach, and the walk up Mount Livermore.

ashore.name: the Angel Island cantina
ashore.say: Oysters and a pitcher on the deck above the cove.

name: Sam's, Tiburon
say: The deck at Sam's Anchor Cafe. Tie up for lunch.

ashore.name: Sam's Anchor Cafe
ashore.say: A table on the deck, a round for the crew, and the gulls after your fries.

name: Sausalito
say: Houseboats, the yacht harbour, and coffee on Bridgeway.

ashore.name: the Sausalito waterfront
ashore.say: Pizza and bocce on the sand, a stone's throw from the dinghy.

name: Aquatic Park
say: The cove under Ghirardelli Square, among the old ships.

ashore.name: the beach at Aquatic Park
ashore.say: Up the steps for an Irish coffee at the cable car turnaround.

name: Pier 39
say: Sea lions and tourists. Mind the ferries.

ashore.name: Pier 39
ashore.say: A crab roll on the pier with the sea lions barking below.

name: Clipper Cove
say: A quiet anchorage between Treasure Island and Yerba Buena.

ashore.name: the Treasure Island beach
ashore.say: A drink on the sand with the whole skyline across the water.

name: Horseshoe Cove
say: Under the north tower of the bridge. A sheltered spot to watch the Gate.

ashore.name: the yacht club at Fort Baker
ashore.say: The bar under the bridge, where the fog comes in over your pint.
